findings.title: Call the passkeys helper with its required argument
findings.body: UsernameForm calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() without arguments, but UsernamePasswordForm defines only isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel), and there is no zero-argument overload in the hierarchy. This causes a compilation error and prevents the services module from building. Pass the context user or provide the intended overload.

findings.title: Preserve passkey initialization when no user is selected
findings.body: The new helper returns false when the user is null, which is the normal state on a fresh login. Both authenticate() and the error challenge path now use this helper to decide whether to call fillContextForm(), so ordinary logins no longer receive the conditional WebAuthn attributes or a stored challenge. This disables existing discoverable-key and explicit passkey login flows, including the initial login required by the new reauthentication tests. Initialization must remain enabled for unidentified users while also supporting reauthentication.
